name: Freelance Project Scout
description: Find paid, well-scoped freelance software projects with a reachable buyer.
targetEntity: A company or founder commissioning a defined software project

criteria.label: Skill fit
criteria.description: The requested work matches the configured technical capabilities.

criteria.label: Scoped project
criteria.description: The buyer describes a concrete deliverable rather than an open-ended resource request.

criteria.label: Reachable buyer
criteria.description: A founder, hiring manager, or project owner can be contacted.

criteria.label: Budget fit
criteria.description: The stated or inferred budget supports professional delivery.

criteria.label: Timeline fit
criteria.description: The expected start and delivery window are workable.

signals.label: Explicit freelancer need
signals.description: The source explicitly asks for a freelancer, consultant, or studio.

signals.label: Public build request
signals.description: A decision maker publicly describes a product or feature they need built.

disqualifiers.label: Unpaid work
disqualifiers.description: The opportunity offers no monetary compensation.

disqualifiers.label: Scam risk
disqualifiers.description: The source or buyer shows strong fraud indicators.

disqualifiers.label: Staff augmentation only
disqualifiers.description: The request is exclusively for hourly staff augmentation.
